newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle firm/up $1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle firm/up $1.00 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers active. Compared with last Monday, sales were firm to $.50 higher, instances $1.00 higher on heifers. - USDA
Slaughter Steers: High Select and Choice 2-3, 1200-1350 lbs 65.50-68.25. Select and Choice 2-3, 1100-1300 lbs 62.50-65.50.
Slaughter Heifers: High Select and Choice 2-3, 1050-1250 lbs 65.00-67.50, 4 loads clean, 65-80 percent Choice 1100-1340 lbs 68.00-68.50. Select and Choice 2-3, 1000-1125 lbs 61.50-65.00.
